title: Publish a new version automatically after a merge that changes the app
story: Before this story a new version only appeared when a person published a release by hand. Now a merge that changes the app publishes the next version automatically once the checks pass on main, and docs-only merges publish nothing. It changes only the release pipeline, with nothing a user can drive inside the app.
no_qa_reason: Only GitHub workflows, a script and docs changed; nothing in the app or on a screen changed.
